Hatfield is a smooth-talking cardsharp who claims to be along to "protect" Lucy, although he seems to have romantic intentions. Dr. Boone is a self-styled philosopher, drunkard and physician who's been stripped of his license. Mr. Peacock is a nervous whiskey salesman. Gatewood is a crooked banker who needs to get out of town. programme.title: Boom America
programme.desc: The episode opens with Michael Bellemare of Switch It Up Inc., who shares how a simple bar-napkin sketch grew into a million-dollar operation specializing in turnkey solar, LED lighting, and EV charging. With a passion for revitalizing the trades, Michael stresses the importance of training programs and investing in people as he maps out his goal of scaling to a $100M company—and even explores franchising with Kevin. Next, teacher-turned-inventor Sean Worthington introduces Raida Tech, where a bathtub question—“What is money?”—led to a new form of data-supremacy currency and safer, uncensored AI. Sean looks to the A-Team for marketing, sales, and customer acquisition support. Then, Dale Krueger of Tangible Assets LLC explains how his coin-collecting hobby evolved into an investment platform blending art and assets, now ready to scale beyond word-of-mouth investors. Finally, Richard Simon of New Home National Title showcases his on-call title insurance service and seeks guidance on breaking into TV advertising to reach homebuyers nationwide.

programme.title: Farm Hero
programme.desc: In the season premiere of Farm Hero, host Laura Zaspel scours the country for the best farming practices and the people behind them. Her search winds her up in Gunnison Colorado at Parker pastures. Bill Parker and his daughters are fighting desertification with their grass-fed livestock. Using a collaboration with local farmers, Bill fights against the stigma of livestock farming with a holistic approach. Parker pastures breathes new air into the concept of farm-to-table.

programme.title: Farm Hero
programme.desc: Ever-increasing rainfall, coupled with monocultural farming, is eradicating the topsoil in Iowa farms. With an estimate that all topsoil in the area will be gone within 35 years, the race is on to change farming culture. Elizabeth Garst and her farm are at the forefront of the fight to educate farmers and the public on the necessity of cover crops and soil health. Elizabeth’s ancestors turned Dust Bowl land into a thriving farm with morals, and she’s not stopping there.

programme.title: Boom America
programme.desc: It’s overhaul day on Boom America, and the A-Team gets to work. Kevin Harrington and Toli Cefail kick things off with Switch It Up, laying out strategies around “The Volume” while Kyle Reyes pushes for a powerful pivot—refocusing the company squarely on the booming trades community. Next, the team digs into Raida Tech, where Laura highlights how the company is operating 25 years ahead of the curve but desperately needs clearer marketing to match its groundbreaking innovation. American Stories creator Bob Cefail stops by to share the inspiration behind Boom America and the future of independent production in the U.S. From there, the A-Team turns to Tangible Assets, helping refine how Dale can monetize his coin collection business, boost credibility, and reach the right investors. Finally, New Home National Title gets a full diagnostic from the experts as they map out how the company can scale, gain visibility, and earn the recognition it deserves nationwide.

programme.title: Boom America
programme.desc: Kevin Harrington and Toli Cefail circle back with the A-Team to map out growth strategies for Law Enforcement Specialists, whose new app has the potential to scale nationwide through smart media outreach. Kyle Reyes takes a personal interest in guiding the process, while the team also welcomes powerhouse attorney Stephen Geday, bringing sharp legal expertise to the roster. David Beavis Photography explores fresh marketing moves and B2B opportunities with designers, laying the groundwork for a gallery launch in Naples, Florida. Provision Brokerage looks to streamline its legacy with a clear plan forward, while new A-Team member Riggs Eckelberry—pioneering disruptor in the water industry—joins the mission. Finally, the team evaluates how Connected & Protected can expand their safety tech beyond seniors and first responders, reaching hospitals and even children.

programme.title: Chaos
programme.desc: A veteran detective is teamed with a rookie cop when they are sent to negotiate with a bunch of criminals holding a bank hostage. It transpires that a master thief has planted a computer virus that will drain funds from the bank's accounts. The detective faces a race against time to catch the thief and stop the randomly evolving computer virus, which models its behavior on the bewildering principles of chaos theory.

programme.title: Blue Hill Avenue
programme.desc: Four friends enter the drug trade in Boston in the late 1970s: Tristan (Allen Payne), Money (Aaron D. Spears), E-Bone and Simon. With the consent of a South End crime boss, Benny (Clarence Williams III), they quickly rise in the drug game, while the leader of the group, Tristan, keeps his double life a secret from his clueless parents. However, as the 1970s pass to the 2000s, a police investigation threatens to ignite a violent feud among the tight-knit friends.

programme.title: Night Train
programme.desc: Greed and betrayal ensnares three people (Danny Glover, Steve Zahn, Leelee Sobieski) when they find a stash of diamonds aboard a train.

programme.title: House Arrest
programme.desc: DeAndre (Jayceon Taylor) becomes involved in a computer chip scheme, and his girlfriend is charged with the crime and placed under house arrest.

programme.title: The Trap
programme.desc: A man returns home to Atlanta to save his family's struggling restaurant with the help of a new chicken recipe.

programme.title: Blood Brother
programme.desc: A recently released convict takes murderous revenge against his childhood friends who let him take the fall for their crimes.

programme.title: Brooklyn's Finest
programme.desc: A drug operation changes the lives of three conflicted New York cops. Burned-out vet Eddie Dugan is close to retirement; narcotics cop Sal Procida faces the difficult task of caring for his large family on his ordinary salary. Undercover officer Clarence Tango Butler finds his loyalties beginning to shift toward a powerful drug dealer. Over seven chaotic days, the three men are drawn toward a fateful crime and destiny.

programme.title: Shottas
programme.desc: Deported from the United States, two drug dealers (Ky-Mani Marley, Spragga Benz) travel to Miami and continue their violent ways.

programme.title: Mansión del Terror
programme.desc: Las extrañas vidas de dos personas son unidas por el amor, pero un mal recuerdo y algunos traumas transformaron todo en una cruel pesadilla.

programme.title: El Mofles en Acapulco
programme.desc: Dos bellas mujeres intentan seducir a un pobre empleado costero para que sea el receptor de un cargamento de droga.

programme.title: Mujeres de medianoche
programme.desc: Después de que una prostituta es asesinada, el novio de esta se entera de la doble vida que ella llevaba.

programme.title: Yako, Cazador de Malditos
programme.desc: Yako tiene que vengarse del hombre que asesinó a su esposa embarazada.

programme.title: Malverde, la leyenda
programme.desc: En el norte de México, un famoso bandolero se gana a la gente al repartir parte del producto de sus robos entre la población.

programme.title: El Hechizo del Pantano
programme.desc: Un niño juega en el bosque con una chiquilla y cuando su padre se entera descubren que ella murió años atrás.

programme.title: El tesoro del amazonas
programme.desc: Un aventurero y sus amigos compiten contra un ex-nazi y otras personas que buscan un tesoro de diamantes en la selva sudamericana.

programme.title: La historia de un gángster
programme.desc: La historia de un delincuente que sale de prisión antes de tiempo por buena conducta, pero este vuelve a meterse en problemas y retoma la vida criminal.

programme.title: La piel de la muerte
programme.desc: Dos mujeres huérfanas protegen un tesoro escondido al que todo el mundo anda buscando en el desierto.

programme.title: Los desalmados
programme.desc: Dos cazarrecompensas se convierten en fieles y buenos amigos, a pesar de los problemas debido a sus profesiones.

programme.title: El Hijo del Otro
programme.desc: Una mujer le habla de su embarazo a su esposo, un hombre estéril. Más tarde él descubre que fue inseminación artificial.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don travels from the north-west coast of Scotland to the north-east coast of England, from historic reconstructions to modern re-inventions. He visits some of the most inhospitable places in the country and finds gardens that are flourishing.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels across some of the country's landscapes, heading across the north of England to Northern Ireland. Here, Monty sees the ingenuity, passion and determination of British people to garden and create gardens, no matter what the canvas.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels across the middle of the country, from Wales to Norfolk. He comes across gardens for gnomes, much-loved, well-tended allotments and extravagant gardens that bankrupted their owners.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don explores the most densely populated part of the country, London and the home counties. He visits some of London's gardens, including a special one on a barge, as well as a beautifully restored garden close to where he grew up in Hampshire.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels across the south-west of the country to visit some of Britain's most exotic gardens. On this journey, Monty also goes to some of the country's most historic gardens, as well as some challenging contemporary ones.

programme.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels to Europe and explores the influence of the Venetians on gardening. To begin with, he explores Venice on one of the city's famous barges, stepping out to visit green spaces large and small that are often hidden from view behind high walls.

programme.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
programme.desc: Monty begins in the city of Trieste, close to Italy's border with Croatia, to visit a public garden first created by an obsessive royal plantsman more than 150 years ago, which is now being carefully restored. He then heads down the Adriatic coast through Croatia to pick up the trail that the Venetians followed, ending his journey on the beautiful island of Lopud, near Dubrovnik.

programme.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
programme.desc: Monty begins the last leg of his journey in Corfu, a Greek island with strong Venetian links, including olive trees planted by them that are still grown today. Here, Monty visits a spectacular garden made by an Englishman with Greek connections.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Join Adam in his garden for a seasonal catch-up. Toby Buckland gives timely tips on summer and autumn maintenance for borders, plus join singer-songwriter Billie Marten as she shares her passion for growing vegetables.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: As the days get shorter, it is a busy time in the garden. Monty Don cracks on with his seasonal tasks at Longmeadow, giving hints and tips along the way. Carol Klein visits first-time gardeners Dan and Dominique for the very last time.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: As autumn unfolds in the garden, Monty Don has plenty to be getting on with at Longmeadow. In his quest to track down some of the nation's most remarkable allotments, Joe Swift visits a tropical paradise in Runcorn.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: With the arrival of October, it is time to start thinking about getting some onions and garlic in the ground, and Monty Don shares his secrets on how to get a successful crop. Elsewhere, Carol Klein takes first-time gardeners Dan and Dominique for a day out in Devon. They are on the hunt for some seasonal inspiration for their new garden and what better place to look than RHS Rosemoor.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty has tips and ideas for planting up garden pots to provide a focal point over the winter months, Rachel visits the tulips of Keukenhof, Joe visits Esther Rantzen's much-loved garden, and Carol visits Glebe Cottage.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: The team visit Bernadette, a dedicated social worker for troubled adults who has always put the needs of others before her own. Having recently turned sixty, Bernadette finally wants some 'me time': a new garden could give her a well-deserved reward.

programme.title: Garden Rescue

programme.title: Gardeners' World

Now that he has harvested his potatoes, that is exactly what he is doing to boost the fertility of the soil for next year.

programme.title: Gardeners' World

programme.title: Gardeners' World

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: Some of the most beautiful rainforest, jungle landscape and wildlife are in Asia. The rainforests of Asia stretch from India and Burma in the west to Malaysia and the islands of Java and Borneo in the east. The Great teak forests and Jungles in Asia have long been under threat from intensive logging and industrial farming of cash crops. Slash and burn agriculture has also taken a heavy toll on the eco-structure and environment. Bangladesh has the largest mangrove forests in the world.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: It might look uniform from the air, as we fly over it, but the oceans are deep and varied. The underwater landscape is made up of continental shelves, volcanoes, mountains, valleys, trenches and large, flat plains similar to the landscape on land only on a much larger scale. Ocean habitats come in all forms. Under water creatures make homes wherever survival is assured.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: The top of New Zealand's South Island is a landscape of two halves. To the West, one of the longest natural sandbars on the planet curves protectively around Golden Bay. To the East, mountains sink into the sea, their drowned river valleys forming the Marlborough Sounds. Turbulent currents connect them, both treacherous and full of riches.
programme.sub-title: Top of the South/ Te Tau Ihu

programme.title: The Enchanted Forest
programme.desc: To spend a day in the forest, from dawn to dusk, is to bathe in nature. There's enchantment at every turn. Throughout the day the cast of characters in the forest changes, from foraging bears to playing fox cubs, dashing hummingbirds and dancing butterflies. But it's as twilight descends, that the most enchanting side of the forest is revealed. Time to watch a firework display curtesy of fireflies. They are the real magicians of the enchanted forest.

programme.title: Hidden Australia
programme.desc: Sometimes called the biggest island on Earth, Australia is a subcontinent of incredible diversity, beauty, danger and downright weirdness.

programme.title: History of Life on Earth - Journey to the Land
programme.desc: As the first landmasses emerged from prehistoric seas, animals took their first steps on dry land. The explosion of life that followed changed the world forever.

programme.title: Sexy Beasts
programme.desc: Driven by surging hormones, every creature on the planet, big or small, will do whatever it takes to find and secure a mate. For some this will take the fight of their lives, while others must preen, prance and party their way to success. From one night stands and group sex to lifelong love and unbreakable bonds, when it comes to finding a mate the animal kingdom has it all. The need to breed manifests itself in all sorts of wonderful antics, displays and behaviours.

programme.title: Mountains - Gateways to Heaven
programme.desc: Mountains define our most spectacular landscapes. As they climb the changing altitude results in a mosaic of dramatic habitats, teaming with incredible wildlife. They're found on every continent on Earth, literally from pole to pole, covering 22% of the planet's surface. An incredibly important part of our ecosystem, a quarter of terrestrial animal and plant species, live in mountains and they house an incredible 85% of all amphibians, mammals and birds.

programme.title: Heroes of the Wild Frontiers
programme.desc: Hunting has been a long-standing cultural tradition in the North Eastern India for long. But with the shirking of the forests and endangering of the wildlife, hunting has become unsustainable. But it is not that this has stopped hunting. The architects of Pakke, a 800 sq Kms forest reserve, in the heart of the hunting villages has done a wonderful job of giving protection to the several endemic species here by keeping the forest safe from the hunters.

programme.title: March (Nature's Calendar)
programme.desc: As northern forests become carpeted by bluebells and wood anemones, and damp corners become singles bars for frogs and a toads, hailing the first hint of spring sun, South Africa needs a break from the heat, fire season is in full swing, threatening the fynbos and the extraordinary animals living in them. Ground squirrels get inventive to find shade. Gray whales migrate up the Californian coast, passing colonies of sea otters. March is a month of change

programme.title: Fight for Territory
programme.desc: Biological instinct is driven by three things: the desire to stay alive, to find food and to breed. But to do all these things, animals first need a home. Out in the wilderness a safe place to call home can be the difference between life and death. A place to secure meals, raise their families and hide from danger. Ideal spots are in short supply and well worth fighting for!

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Argentina
programme.desc: Stretching almost 1000 miles, from the jungles of Brazil to the southernmost point of South America, Patagonia's coast is home to some of the natural world's most spectacular animals. Here, a parched desert collides with a powerful ocean, but right along this extreme and hostile coastline, animals battle the elements and each other, in a fight for survival.

programme.title: Wild and Alive
programme.desc: On the savannah of southern Africa, rains have turned the land green and lush. It's the time of plenty and for the cast of wild characters here, cashing in is priority number one. From polecat to aardwolf, some of the continent's most seldom seen creatures are out to make the most of the abundance. Some families gorge on the plentiful grasses, while for others there's no such thing as an easy meal, even at this time of year.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Europe
programme.desc: The story of Europe's living waters begins at great altitude. Melt waters from the highest snow-capped peaks feed some of the greatest rivers. On their relentless downward journey, streams and rivers have carved through all of Europe's greatest landscapes. Gorges, lakes and wetlands are home to an incredible array of wildlife and seas and oceans have sculpted a coastline of endless variety.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Islands
programme.desc: The Falkland Islands' pristine coastlines and bountiful seas offer a lifeline and breeding centre for millions of penguins each year. Though while some find sanctuary on dry land, there's a daily battle to survive in the waters which surround these wild and rocky shores.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Europe
programme.desc: Over the last million years, our planet suffered a series of major ice-ages. Much of the northern hemisphere was covered in ice sheets several kilometres thick and creatures had no choice but to adapt or die. Over time, temperatures rose, causing these glaciers to retreat, however, in certain parts of Europe the ice-age never left. For many creatures, the struggle to survive 'a life below zero' continues.

programme.title: History of Life on Earth - Rise of the Giants
programme.desc: In the great story of life, reptiles were one of the first major players. For 180 million years they ruled the land, seas and skies - this was the rise of the giants.

programme.title: Coasts - Rolling with the Waves
programme.desc: We love our coasts, and so do animals! The corridor of water where the open ocean transitions into coastal habitat is known as the surf zone. The churning forces of the waves clashing with the land make these some of the most food-rich waters on Earth. Nutrients are both washed off the coast from rain and rivers, but also pushed up from the depths thanks to waves and currents.

programme.title: Hannah Goes to Namibia
programme.desc: As soon as she arrives, conservationist Hannah Emde immerses herself in Namibia's wildlife. The first destination of her trip is the world-famous Naankuse Foundation near Windhoek. In addition to a veterinary clinic, the sanctuary includes 85,000 hectares of wilderness, where endangered and rescued animals live.

programme.title: Wolves - Power of the Pack
programme.desc: From arctic tundra to the great planes, the kingdom of the wolf extends across the entire northern hemisphere. They are icons of the wilderness, spectacular creatures that live and die by the sword. Though magnificent predators on their own, the feature that perhaps makes wolves so iconic is the pack. The close bonds, complex communication and sheer muscle of a team of wolves is almost unstoppable. And the pack's not just the day job, it's the cornerstone of family life for a wolf.

programme.title: Wildest Islands
programme.desc: Lying like a teardrop in the Indian Ocean, Sri Lanka is an island that defies convention. Poised just six degrees above the equator, it's less than 75,000 km sq in size. But it has enough wildlife to rival a continent, and it's all down to its complicated climate and geography.

programme.title: The Eye
programme.desc: Blind for most of her life, concert violinist Sydney Wells (Jessica Alba) is the recipient of a double corneal transplant that restores her sight at long last. With the help of her doctor (Alessandro Nivola) and sister (Parker Posey), she learns to see again. Soon, however, frightening visions convince her that a terrifying alternate world exists, and only she can see it.

programme.title: Stir of Echoes
programme.desc: Blue-collar family man Tom Witzky (Kevin Bacon) scoffs at supernatural phenomena -- until he lets his wife's sister, Lisa (Illeana Douglas), put him into a hypnotic trance. Upon waking, Tom realizes he has a psychic connection with his son, Jake (Zachary David Cope). He also has alarming hallucinations of a missing teenage neighbor named Samantha (Jennifer Morrison). Tom, convinced his visions will lead him to the girl, begins a desperate search that puts him into a life-threatening situation.

programme.title: Stir of Echoes: The Homecoming
programme.desc: Capt. Ted Cogan (Rob Lowe) returns from the war in Iraq and is haunted by visions of a burned man. After he is denied help by the government, a psychic tells him to find out what the burned man wants.

programme.title: Sinister
programme.desc: True-crime writer Ellison Oswald is in a slump; he hasn't had a bestseller in more than 10 years and is becoming increasingly desperate for a hit. So, when he discovers the existence of a snuff film showing the deaths of a family, he vows to solve the mystery. He moves his own family into the victims' home and gets to work. However, when old film footage and other clues hint at the presence of a supernatural force, Ellison learns that living in the house may be fatal.

programme.title: Mara
programme.desc: A criminal psychologist investigates the mysterious strangling death of a man in his bed. She soon meets members of a community who tell her about a centuries-old demon that kills people in their sleep.

programme.title: King Cobra
programme.desc: Dr. Burns (Joseph Ruskin) is experimenting with snake venom as a means of controlling violent tendencies in humans when things go wrong and a giant cobra escapes from his lab and into a small town. Snake-bitten bodies turn up everywhere, and the mayor of the town, Ed Biddle (Hoyt Axton), wants things hushed up to protect the town's upcoming microbrewery festival. Expert reptile wrangler Nick Hashimoto (Pat Morita) is then hired to bring in the snake before things spiral out of control.

programme.title: Arachnid
programme.desc: After the disappearance of her brother on an isolated island, pilot Mercer (Alex Reid) readily accepts an offer to fly a team of ex-Marines and scientists to the same remote isle so they can investigate a strange series of deadly animal bites. Unfortunately, Mercer is forced to make a crash landing there. Soon, one of her colleagues suffers a lethal bite, and insect expert Henry Capri (Ravil Isyanov) makes a startling revelation: They are stranded on an island overrun with huge mutant spiders.

programme.title: Mongolian Death Worm
programme.desc: An oil company uses the dangerous fracking method to capture oil, and wakes a nest of deadly creatures that have been dormant for centuries, the Mongolian Death Worms.

programme.title: Sharktopus
programme.desc: Genetically engineered, a monster that is half-shark and half-octopus goes on a killing spree.

programme.title: Dinoshark
programme.desc: A prehistoric shark unfreezes from an Arctic glacier and finds a feeding ground full of tourists and locals near Puerto Vallarta, Mexico.

programme.title: Dinocroc vs. Supergator
programme.desc: A biotech company creates two gigantic reptiles in a secret island laboratory. When the massive creatures escape, an undercover investigator, a Fish and Game officer and a swamp hunter team up to track down and kill the beasts.

programme.title: The Best of Enemies
programme.desc: The true story of the unlikely relationship between Ann Atwater, an outspoken civil rights activist, and C.P. Ellis, a local Ku Klux Klan leader. During the racially charged summer of 1971, Atwater and Ellis come together to co-chair a community summit on the desegregation of schools in Durham, N.C. The ensuing debate and battle soon lead to surprising revelations that change both of their lives forever.

programme.title: Hard Luck Love Song
programme.desc: A chance encounter with an old love and a series of bad decisions place a down-on-his-luck troubadour at an existential crossroad.

programme.title: Plane
programme.desc: Pilot Brodie Torrance saves passengers from a lightning strike by making a risky landing on a war-torn island -- only to find that surviving the landing was just the beginning. When dangerous rebels take most of the passengers hostage, the only person Torrance can count on for help is Louis Gaspare, an accused murderer who was being transported by the FBI.

programme.title: Southpaw
programme.desc: Billy "The Great" Hope (Jake Gyllenhaal), the reigning junior middleweight boxing champion, has an impressive career, a loving wife and daughter, and a lavish lifestyle. However, when tragedy strikes, Billy hits rock bottom, losing his family, his house and his manager. He soon finds an unlikely savior in Tick Willis (Forest Whitaker), a former fighter who trains the city's toughest amateur boxers. With his future on the line, Hope fights to reclaim the trust of those he loves the most.

programme.title: Warrior
programme.desc: An estranged family finds redemption in the unlikeliest of places: the MMA ring. Tommy (Tom Hardy), an ex-Marine with a tragic past, returns home and enlists his father (Nick Nolte), a recovering alcoholic and former wrestling coach, to train him for "Sparta," the biggest MMA tournament ever held. But when Tommy's underdog brother, Brendan (Joel Edgerton), fights his way into the tournament, the two brothers must finally confront each other and the forces that pulled them apart.

programme.desc: A determined female boxer tries to break down barriers as she redefines what it means to be a woman in today's world. When a former boxing champion accepts the challenge to train her, the two mismatched partners form an unlikely alliance.

Transformed from upstanding citizen to cold-blooded vigilante, Coxman unwittingly sets off a chain of events that includes a kidnapping, a series of deadly misunderstandings and a turf war between Viking and a rival boss.

programme.desc: On the first episode back since Grant made his announcement that he wasleaving, TAPS pushes forward focusing on the case on hand. They head to the University of Rhode Island to investigate a Fraternity house that has been experiencing paranormal activity for decades. Purchased in 1936, a former Governor once resided in the house, and there is a claim that his little girl, Abigail, fell to her death there.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to South Carolina, the winner of America's Hometown Ghost Hunters Contest, to investigate the renowned Old City Jail. This historical Jail was the final destination of America's first female serial killer, Lavinia Fisher. It's believed that Lavinia still lingers in the prison and it is up to TAPS to determine if that's true. This site has been around since 1738, when it was first used as a workhouse for slaves and a makeshift hospital for paupers, vagrants, and beggars.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads out on their first case since co-founder Grant Wilson left. This case takes them to New Orleans, Louisiana to investigate what's locally known as the Upstairs Fire at Jimani Lounge. The current owner, Jimmy Jr. was only 12 years old when an arsonist set fire to his father's club on June 24th, 1973. 32 men died trying to escape, but because these men were associated with the gay community, many bodies were never claimed, therefore, victims were never identified. Jimmy Jr.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS is called back to Alexandria, Louisiana to investigate the Alexandria Zoo, where the apparition of the longtime zookeeper and manager, Les has been seen. Les' longtime friend, Bill Hess called in TAPS after many longtime employees and friends noticed strange paranormal activity that reminded them of their dear friend. TAPS also introduces a new member, Ashley to the team and Jason promotes Adam to his new position, Investigator.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is asked to investigate Fort Ontario, a place that was the only location in America to provide sanctuary for Jewish refugees during World War II. Built in 1755, this fort first saw battle during the French and Indian war, and is no stranger to bloodshed. ...and phenomena.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Baton Rouge, Louisiana to investigate the Old State Capital Building. Built in 1852, this building has seen countless politicians come through its doors including congressman, Pierre Couvillon, who died during a heated debate opposing gambling. The building also survived the Civil War, during which the Union Army used the basement as a prison.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Claremont, New Hampshire to investigate a former shoe and furniture factory, the Topstone Mill. What was once an abandoned space has now become a restaurant and bar... with frequent visitors from "the other side." Could deceased workers from the 1900's be trying to contact a mother and son team who own the bar? TAPS has surprising evidence that could point in that direction.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Lockport, New York to investigate an underworld of tunnels. It holds a mystery of possible murders, multiple deaths and frightening phenomena. What stories do the spirits of Lockport Caves want to tell? Will TAPS be able to reassure their client that visitors will be safe if they venture on one of the longest underground boat rides in America? Next up, the team travels to Skaneateles, New York to investigate the Fuller House.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Hampton Falls, New Hampshire to investigate the Governor's Mansion, a property Steve has investigated before with a local team. Could this estate's hauntings be connected to a sad secret surrounding a little boy who is believed to have once lived here in the late 1800's? Will TAPS be able to reach this child and find out if he was in fact the hidden legitimate son of State Senator, Warren Brown? Could the State Senator have been behind his murder?

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Bowling Green, Kentucky to investigate Western Kentucky University. This University was established in 1906 and has 20,000 students attending. Tamela Smith is the client, and has called TAPS in to figure out if some of the stories that have been passed down over the decades are folklore or truth. There are three main stories that surround the school.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Rochester, New York to investigate the Rochester Public Library's 15 years of claims. There's reason to believe that two deaths associated with the building could be behind the activity. The library wants to go public with the phenomena but only if accurate. Can TAPS find the answer they are looking for and finally let the public in on this library's long-held secret?

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS returns to Hartford, Connecticut to investigate the Mark Twain House. With their previous investigation marred by malfunctioning equipment, TAPS is being called back to look into new and frightening claims that could finally uncover who is residing there. Will Samuel Clemens' favorite holiday initiate an appearance from the famous author? Or will his three children try to reach out to TAPS?

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Hollywood, California to investigate the infamous Black Dahlia murder at the historic Sowden House. Aspiring actress, Elizabeth Short was nicknamed the Black Dahlia after her brutal murder and the leading suspect of that horrific crime was never convicted. Two people have called in TAPS; the first being the main murder suspects own son, Steve Hodel.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Bartonville, Illinois, to investigate Peoria Asylum. The owners are renovating this building and have noticed a lot of paranormal activity since they started their restorations. Built in 1898 and opened in 1902, it is said that 16,000 people died there, from multiple reasons, including, patients killing patients and suicide. The asylum's records hold two key figures; Dr.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Cortland, New York to investigate The 1890 House. Industrialist, Chester Wickwire built this home for his family, and even though they have long passed, it's believed by some that the family may still reside here. Michelle, the caretaker, is concerned that the spirits may follow her home. Do the Wickwire's still live in their former home and if so, can TAPS help put Michelle's mind at ease that they mean her no harm?

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Louisville, Kentucky to investigate the oldest operating steamboat in the United States. The boat was built in 1914 and has been used for everything from dances to gambling. Its former Captain Winters was legendary for being somewhat shady. It's claimed that he killed a deckhand named Floyd during an argument when he sent him to do work on the paddle wheel and then ordered full steam ahead, which killed Floyd.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Coventry, Connecticut to investigate the Nathan Hale Homestead. Nathan Hale was an American Patriot who fought in the Revolutionary War and was executed by hanging by the British for being a spy. He was left outside hanging for days to send a message. He was then dumped in an unmarked grave. Now our client, Bev, believes he has come back to his childhood home. His house was built in 1776 and in the 1940's was turned into a museum.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Shreveport, Louisiana to investigate the Shreveport Auditorium, a place that is famous for introducing Elvis to the world. Shreveport Auditorium opened in 1929 and is considered a national landmark. The auditorium's stage has been graced by such stars as Hank Williams and Johnny Cash and is known as the first place Elvis preformed professionally. A statue of Elvis was erected after he passed and that's when the phenomena is said to have begun.
programme.sub-title: The Ghost Hasn't Left the Building

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Little Rock, Arkansas to investigate a personal case at the Jones House and their bungalow next door. Robberies, fires, assault, and murder have all taken place in the old bungalow, dating back to 1898, when Ed Cornish had his wife and two children die 16 hours apart. Then in 2005 Bonnie Wallace, the Jones' neighbor, was murdered by an acquaintance in the bungalow and her husband, Paul died shortly after from illness.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters

Even though Britain remains undefeated, it is so isolated that Hitler has no concerns about turning his attention East. Operation Barbarossa, the German invasion of the USSR, takes the Soviets completely by surprise and the Red Army suffers terrible casualties.

programme.title: Military Legends of World War II

programme.title: The Hawker Hurricane
programme.desc: The Hawker Hurricane was the first fighter monoplane to join the Royal Air Force and the first combat aircraft adopted by that arm capable of exceeding 300 mph in level flight. The Hurricane shouldered the lion s share of Britain s defence during the Battle of Britain. This program portrays the history of this legendary aircraft which was to form an immortal partnership during the infamous battle.

programme.title: Hunting Down The Nazis
programme.desc: Simon Wiesenthal, a survivor of the death camps, is hunting down his torturers, from the camp Kapos to Mengele, the mad doctor of Auschwitz. Lawyer and historian Serge Klarsfeld, whose father was deported and murdered, has devoted his life to searching for Nazi leaders still at large. For the first time a film recounts the story of the long pursuit of Nazis in hiding, from 1945 to the present day.

programme.title: Line of Fire: Stalingrad
programme.desc: This documentary traces the battle for Stalingrad, which proved to be the turning point for the Allies on the eastern front during the Second World War. Included is expert analysis by Dr Duncan Anderson and Dr Aryk Nusbacher. The bitter, bloody and inhuman struggle for Stalingrad was the turning point of the war on the eastern front and a pivotal moment of World War Two.

programme.title: WWII: On the Edge of the Abyss
programme.desc: The final episode covers Japan's surrender and the formal end of World War II. The world begins to reckon with the scale of devastation, from the ruins of Europe to the atomic wastelands of Japan. The episode also examines the aftermath of the war, the beginning of the Cold War, and how the lessons of World War II shaped the modern world.

programme.title: WWII: The Price of Empire
programme.desc: It took Hitler half a war to gain an empire But it would also take him half a war to lose one Japan also wound up growing and growing only to start to fall about halfway through the war.

programme.title: The Korean War

programme.title: Nazi War Criminals
programme.desc: This film permanently and accurately documents the trial of the Nazi defendants at Nuremberg. It includes German footage of Nazi personalities and activities interwoven with film shot during the trials. It follows the story of the rise and fall of Nazism from the putsch in a Munich beer hall to the Nuremberg trials, and contains flashbacks of a variety of Nazi crimes against humanity.

programme.title: WWII: On the Edge of the Abyss
programme.desc: As Germany moves westward, this episode covers the dramatic fall of France and the rapid conquest of several European countries. Attention is given to the Dunkirk evacuation, where Allied forces narrowly escaped annihilation, and the political turmoil in Europe as Hitler's dominance over the continent grows.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: In 1945, the U.S. ended WWII with atomic bombs on Hiroshima and Nagasaki, killing over 180,000. But the bomb's story began in Nazi Germany, prompting Roosevelt's $26B Manhattan Project to beat Hitler-and the Soviets-in a race for the A-bomb. Through archives and eyewitnesses, this film reveals the fierce arms race that shaped the fate of the world.
programme.sub-title: WWII - The Secret Race to the Atomic Bomb

programme.title: WWII: The Price of Empire

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Rutila se resigna a que Sebastián tenía marcado su destino, por soplón. Aurelio se encargará de Tony. Rodrigo, Evelyn y Erica tienen todo listo para grabar al presidente. Evelyn, bajo anonimato.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Rivero difunde un mensaje por TV que pone en una encrucijada al presidente. Le advierte que está a tiempo de salvar al país. Aurelio tiene la solución y le dice a Terán, que siga sus instrucciones.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Hay un tiroteo entre los bandos de Rodrigo y Aurelio. Rutila interviene al saber que Rodrigo corre peligro. Este, escondido junto a Evelyn, espera lo peor. Casillas ordena frenar a su hija, como sea.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Omar dice y hace lo que le manda El Señor de los Cielos. Rodrigo es un traidor, aliado de una oficial prófuga y del líder del cártel de Chicago. Casillas triunfa en nombre de una conspiración.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Los militares ejecutan la orden de cateo. Están tras una pista del crimen de Rivero. Si Uzcátegui interfiere con la justicia, podría ser acusada legalmente. La grabación está a salvo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Pilar se sincera con Aurelio y le pregunta si ella terminará como sus exmujeres. Decide seguirlo a México. Aurelio hace planes de negocios con Ninon y ella no puede ocultar que le atrae.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ninón coquetea con Aurelio, pero sus ganas de quedarse con él, provocan una investigación y el deseo de sacarla de su camino. Pilar reclama las escenas seductoras y él propone un trío.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: La Marina y la DEA allanan el rancho de Casillas, pero no sin antes intercambiar disparos. Aurelio, la Niña, Vitamina, el Chatarrero y Mónica se esconden. Dalvio tiene un camión lleno de coca.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ismael le muestra a Aurelio la foto de un cartel colocado por los padres de Esperanza. Casillas llama a Juan Carlos y le advierte, con vulgaridades, que además de su hija, alguien más morirá.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ninón no soporta a Pilar, así que Ahmed y otros matones a su servicio cumplen con la orden de la Madame. Vitaminas y Zopilote la buscan. Miranda, lista para ocupar el lugar de la Tata.
programme.sub-title: Ninón se encarga de su rival

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Pilar está desaparecida, Aurelio y la Felina la buscan. Aurelio da con Esperanza, ella llama a Salazar. Ninón se confiesa con su hijo, ve una foto del padre y descubre que hace negocios sucios.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Tony y Mónica expresan su filosofía de vida y por qué se dedican al narcotráfico. Para ella la verdadera felicidad no existe. La Felina, preocupada por Pilar, la llama y otra persona responde.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Esperanza llama a Aurelio y pide que la deje en paz. Casillas la tilda de traidora por haberle "vendido" todo a la DEA. Jura venganza, es cuestión de tiempo. Tony quiere una vida con Mónica.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aunque tiene el video de Rodrigo bajo la manga, Carla Uzcátegui quiere una entrevista con Rutila. Le dice lo que le gusta oír: la han perseguido, pero es un ejemplo para las mujeres del país.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Tony está listo para liquidar a Aurelio. Mónica, sin saberlo, sirve de carnada. La Felina oye una propuesta. Leonardo insiste en hacerse cargo del negocio de Ninón. Los narcos preparan alianzas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Eunice y Ninón, frente a frente en la morgue donde están los restos de Pilar. La Felina a punta de pistola amenaza con asesinarla, por haber liquidado a su amiga. Exige exámenes toxicológicos.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Rutila y Javi se acercan más de la cuenta, acuerdan no mencionar a Aurelio Casillas. Mónica abandona a Tony, su único nexo será el negocio. La Felina tras la pista del celular de Pilar.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Rutila le concederá la entrevista a Uzcátegui, en la cual, promete hablar de todo. La Felina consigue pistas sobre Pilar y le pide a Aurelio que investigue más; pero sin la ayuda de Ninón.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio y Mónica tienen una cita cargada de sinceridad, nostalgia, reproches y traiciones, sollozan y beben. Él cede, pero no tanto. La Felina conoce a Leonardo, el punto débil de Ninón.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Cuando Esperanza contacta a Ismael, rastrean la llamada. En España, Aurelio sigue deprimido tras la desaparición de Pilar; recuerda sus encuentros con Mónica y promete eliminar a Esperanza.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Javi lleva a Rutila el dinero que Aurelio le robó. Tienen un romance. Él la invita a Colombia. Ella no quiere nada serio con él, solo sexo, pero él está pensando en un compromiso.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Penumbra le manda una foto de Salazar a Aurelio para que lo reconozca. El agente dice que dejen de perseguir a Esperanza, que ella no lo entregó, él la obligó. Lo torturan para que hable.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Tony Pastrana decide proteger a Esperanza y hacerla su socia, para eliminar a Aurelio. Ella tiene miedo, pero Tony le asegura que vivirá. Mónica se entera de la relación de Rutila y Javier.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Omar va a Cuba y entrega una casa a cambio de su boda con Lorena, ahora quiere el divorcio. Luisa toma fotografías y videos de mujeres en baños públicos y luego los expone en galerías de arte.
programme.sub-title: De oveja a loba; Baño de mujeres

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Enrique tiene un comportamiento sexual con su nieta, aprovecha cuando la carga en su silla de ruedas. Adriana anda completamente desnuda dentro de su propiedad y Sandor la odia por eso.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Diana y Darío se enfrentan a una decisión de vida o muerte, la gestación de sus gemelos: uno de ellos tiene problemas cardíacos y su vida corre peligro, pero una intervención quirúrgica podría afectar al otro bebé. Óscar, deseoso de ser un político, se postuló a concejal; pero Yalissa declaró que fue víctima de abusos continuados por parte de Óscar, quien le ofreció plata para que no dijera nada.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Quiere vender su casa, pero no obtiene el precio que pide por la influencia de su vecina neonazi. Su hermano pequeño va a un colegio religioso donde el rector es el sacerdote que abusó de él.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Nora y Daniel tuvieron relaciones, ella estaba borracha y dice que él la violó, pero él argumenta que la confundió con la joven con la que tenía una cita. Tika quiere convertirse en gato.
programme.sub-title: Abusada por error; Quiero ser gato

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Carolina se reencuentra con su hija y su esposo, después de tres años, y descubre que la niña vive aislada del mundo. Felicia demanda a su marido por seguir un método japonés para ser feliz.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Juan está convencido de que es una mujer, su esposa, Liscar, le exige que vaya a terapia. Ariana tiene muchas cucarachas en su casa y como su amiga Claudia les tiene miedo, la demanda.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Alegnis se arrepintió después de haberse sometido a 10 cirugías estéticas para convertirse en la copia de la exesposa de su marido. Carolina causó un accidente mortal con una patineta.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Trajo a su hijo a vivir con él, ahora el chico sufre las torturas del padre, quien no acepta su orientación sexual. Cayó en depresión por la infidelidad de su esposo y la dan por muerta.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: El hijo de Iván y Mery murió. La madre siente una especial conexión con el búho del niño, el padre quiere que se deshaga de él. Alejandro exige el divorcio porque le practican acupuntura anal.
programme.sub-title: El mensaje del búho; Acupuntura anal

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Se excita al escuchar a la gente mientras hacen el amor, hasta que fue su esposa quien gritó de placer. Tania está en su auto con un stripper, su esposo la descubre y se produce un accidente.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Atropella a un cerdo en la calle y lo cocina, Dayamit dice que era su mascota. Livi escapó con su dote de 60 mil dólares, la madre quiere que la devuelva si no se casa, pero ella ya la usó.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Asegura que a su papá lo deportaron por una pelea provocada, pero al parecer el señor es de cuidado. Dice que el amante de su esposa ha sido una bendición, quiere que viva con ellos.
programme.sub-title: Asilo político; Viviendo con el amante

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Nelly deja los hábitos, siendo monja, para casarse con Lupita, pero vive un infierno y quiere el divorcio. Enilda demanda a René, durante un incendio él salva los carros y abandona a la abuela.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Marco exige 20 mil dólares a Karen por grabar y subir a las redes el ataque homofóbico del que fue víctima su hermana. Rhina pide una indemnización, sus hijos ven pornografía por culpa de Rubí.
programme.sub-title: Intolerancia gay; Pervirtiendo a mis niños

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Néstor es un transexual que habla y se viste como la Dra. Polo. Además, Osni y Edith, quienes compran "storages" y venden los productos que encuentran, discuten por un radio viejo con una nota.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Isidro maneja sus finanzas solo con dinero en efectivo y al perder sus ahorros, demanda a su pareja. Mercedes enseña ciencias con experimentos prácticos, una estudiante se quema con hielo.
programme.sub-title: El regalo de Santa; Experimento en clases

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Antonio le exige a su ex, quien lo golpeó en los genitales, que pague los gastos médicos. Gabo quiere anular la paternidad del hijo que tiene con Valery, porque no lo concibió conscientemente.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Zamira padece glaucoma y su esposo quiere que reciba atención médica, ella pide un tratamiento natural. Karina quiere el divorcio de Luz, cree que su saliva es sanadora y cura con la lengua.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Mónica le pide a Verónica, su ex, el dinero que le dio para invertir en su negocio, hay intereses ocultos. Alberto despierta del coma y no recuerda su boda con un transexual, quiere anularla.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Alfonso demanda a su esposa, ella se cree productora y quiere que los hijos sean grandes artistas. Exige orden de alejamiento contra la dueña de un restaurante donde dejó una mala opinión.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Pedro quiere internar a su hermano en el manicomio por poner su vida en peligro para ganar un premio Darwin. Raquel pide el divorcio, su esposo enfrentará a su amante en un duelo medieval.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Daniel come un pez globo, muy venenoso y cae en coma, ahora demanda al restaurante donde lo consumió. Ambas son cantantes, pero Aylinne usa su trabajo para traficar droga, y acusan a Bella.
